data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 asserts a dependence/reduction relation on a mischaracterized causal mechanism. It frames the premium-only decomposition (base-for-all plus overtime premium) as 'structurally differs from the standard method ... by overcounting base pay for overtime hours.' But the premium-only method (47×$18 + 7×$9) and the standard piecewise method (40×18 + 7×27) are algebraically equivalent: (47×18 + 7×9) = (40×18 + 7×18 + 7×9) = (40×18 + 7×27). There is no overcounting—the 'extra' base in the premium-only method is exactly compensated by paying only a half-time premium rather than 1.5× full overtime. The target invents a causal discrepancy where none exists, refuting its own premise that the methods 'structurally differ' by overcounting.
